# Tests that are known to fail when every entity is routed to postgres
# (DB_ROUTING=default=postgres). They are skipped in the postgres CI leg and
# in `make test-postgres`, so the leg can be blocking for everything else.

# One top-level test name per line. Remove a line once the test passes on
# postgres - a newly failing test must not be added here without an issue.
